name: Converters
description: Convert units of measure and currencies, with rates you type in yourself.
ratesHint: Rates are typed in by hand, no connection is used. Read them as: 1 {base} = rate of the currency.

errors.unknown_unit: This unit does not exist for this quantity.
errors.invalid_value: The value must be a number.
errors.invalid_currency: Invalid currency code: three uppercase letters, and not the euro.
errors.invalid_rate: The rate must be a number greater than zero.
errors.unknown_currency: Unknown currency: add its rate first.
